title: The microfilm
logline: The Newport college paper on microfilm: September 1999, the first daily, blue-white on a reader's screen, the crank, the reflection of a man's face in the glass over his own first daily.

panels.composition: A microfilm reader's screen glowing blue-white with a 1999 college newspaper page on it, the first weekday daily visible in its corner, the crank handle at the side, and in the screen's glass a faint reflection of the face looking at it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a microfilm reader's blue-white screen showing a 1999 newspaper page with a small four-panel comic in its corner, a crank handle at the side, a faint reflection of a graying man's face in the glass, no words
image.notes: dw_1999-09-20 on film. The face only as a reflection over it.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: His first daily on film; his face in the glass over it.
